Focus on how these accounts are treated under Australian tax law once the person is an Australian tax resident, how the US–Australia tax treaty applies, and what constraints or opportunities exist for withdrawals, rollovers, conversions, or maintaining the accounts. Include analysis of Australian taxation of foreign retirement accounts, US rules for US citizens abroad, PFIC considerations, and any reporting obligations required by both countries. Prioritise authoritative Australian and US sources and provide citations from the websites you access. 

NEVER FABRICATE SOURCES. ALL SOURCES MUST BE REAL
